verdicts.rationale: The C6 Electro Infusion is a genuinely unauthored effect (curator note: 'reviewer to author'). It is expressible with the wired `infuse` Effect exactly as Bennett authors his C6 Pyro infusion and Kazuha his C6 Anemo self-infusion: a target 'self' infusion gated on constellation 6, triggered onCast of the skill, fixed 3s duration, element electro. Implement rather than caveat, per implement-first. The `infuse` Effect feeds the Team Builder capability facet; it does not recolor the planner's normal-attack element (that reads the static normal-ability infusion field, not the Effect), but Bennett and Kazuha ship this exact residual with no caveat, so none is warranted here.
verdicts.implementSpec: Author on the skill's effects[] (Bennett/Kazuha put the C6-gated infuse on the base ability, not the constellation entry): { type: 'infuse', target: 'self', trigger: { type: 'onCast', ability: 'skill' }, duration: 3, durationType: 'fixed', element: 'electro', conditions: { type: 'constellation', level: 6 } }.

verdicts.rationale: The burst heal and energy are plain onCast effects, deliberately not authored on summons[], so they produce no timeline surface (heals render only as summonTick markers on a summon, as Bennett's field does). With nothing rendered, the 'Jinni re-connects to the new active on post-cast swap' redirect and the 'ticks suppressed on leaving the burst area' suppression have no surface to diverge from; energy and AoE positioning are constitution-excluded regardless. The connected-character Electro self-application is an aura/reaction mechanic with no infusion-of-recipient primitive and an explicitly uncertain duration (gcsim TODO) — a CANNOT-model gap matching the Jean field-imbue precedent, which carries no caveat.

verdicts.rationale: The only flagged divergence here is the C6 Electro Infusion, which the note itself cross-references to the skill; it is authored there (see the skill verdict, per Bennett/Kazuha base-ability + constellation-gate precedent), so nothing is added on the constellation entry. The sibling C6 team heal is a plain heal effect (no summon), so it renders no timeline surface regardless of whether its trigger stays manual or is wired to onHit — heals only render as summon tick markers — leaving no rendered divergence to repair.
